ई: ई 1. ई, the fourth letter of the alphabet, corresponding to इ long, and having the sound of एए in feel.
ई 2. ई, ईस्, m., N. of Kandarpa, the god of love; ई or ईस्, f., N. of Lakṣmī.
ई 3. ई, ind. an interjection of pain, anger, consciousness or perception, consideration, compassion.
ई 4. ई for rt. इ। See under 5. इ।

A. ईक्षते, ईक्षाञ्-चक्रे, ईक्षिष्यते, ऐक्षिष्ट, ईक्षितुम्, to see, look, view, behold, look at, gaze at (with acc. or rarely loc.); to see in one's mind, think, have a thought, regard, consider; to look to the welfare of any one (with dat.): Caus. ईक्षयति, -यितुम्, to make one look at (with acc.). ईक्षमाण: ईक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, looking at, surveying.
ईक्षित: ईक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, seen, beheld, regarded.
ईक्षितृ: ईक्षितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, seeing, beholding, a beholder.

ईक्ष्यमाण: ईक्ष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being beheld, being viewed.

ईज्: ईज् ईज् or ईञ्ज्, cl. 1. P. ईजति, ईजाञ्-चकार, ईजितुम् or ईञ्जति, &c., to go; to blame or censure.
ईजिक: ईजिक ईजिक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
